name: shaadicount
description: ShaadiCount - function-specific RSVP, reminders, catering estimates and check-in for Indian weddings (MVP)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,worker,web -c blue,magenta,green "npm run dev -w @shaadicount/api" "npm run dev:worker -w @shaadicount/api" "npm run dev -w @shaadicount/web"
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @shaadicount/api && npm run lint -w @shaadicount/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @shaadicount/api && npm run typecheck -w @shaadicount/web
scripts.test:unit: npm run test:unit -w @shaadicount/api && npm run test -w @shaadicount/web
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration && npm run test:e2e
scripts.build: npm run build -w @shaadicount/api && npm run build -w @shaadicount/web
